text:
My daily routine is built around consistency, which helps me stay productive and relaxed. I wake up at six-thirty every morning, and my first habit is drinking a large glass of water before making coffee. After a quick shower, I sit down to review my schedule for the day.

My work hours start at nine and end around five. I usually focus on my main tasks in the morning when I have the most energy, and I take a short walk during my lunch break. In the afternoon, I answer emails and attend meetings.

After work, I do thirty minutes of exercise, either jogging in the park or doing yoga at home. In the evening, I prepare a simple dinner, read a book, and plan the next day’s to-do list. By ten-thirty, I am in bed. This steady rhythm keeps me feeling calm and in control.
